calibration.comparables_rule: priced live-token peers only: mcap_usd > 0 with CoinGecko id and symbol (16 zero/negative-mcap dead tokens excluded)
calibration.category_median_rule: category median used only at n >= 10 priced comparables (qualifying: Lending 15, Dexs 11)
calibration.fallback_rule: thin cohorts (n < 10) use the overall priced median (0.2138, n=128), flagged peer_multiple_fallback_used
calibration.cap_rule: headline implied capped at 3x the size-adjusted log-curve implied value (cap_applied flag per row)
calibration.stability_note: snapshot carries no 30-day TVL series, so stability S = 1.00 for every row

formulas.implied: implied_i = TVL_i × M_cat(i) × G_i × A_i × B_i × S_i
formulas.ev_farm: EV = p_launch × E[airdrop|launch] − total_costs − capital × 4.2% × hold_days/365
